Acerca del empleo
Remote, Full Time, Individual Contributor, +4 years of experience
Who We Are
At Quorvia, we are building the payment infrastructure that enables all companies to participate in the global market. Founded by a team of seasoned experts in the payments and IT industries, Quorvia provides a high-performance payment orchestrator. Our technology offers companies access to leading payment capabilities, allowing them to engage customers confidently and maintain global business operations with seamless payment integrations worldwide.
Shape your future with Quorvia!
We are orchestrating the best high-performing team!
We are looking for a Senior AI Engineer with extensive experience building products powered by Large Language Models (LLMs) and deep expertise in prompt engineering. In this role, you will spearhead the development of innovative AI-driven solutions tailored to our end users, enabling Quorvia to redefine the payment landscape.
As a key member of our AI Product Team, you will design, implement, and optimize AI-powered systems that enhance user experiences and solve complex challenges in payment orchestration. If you’re passionate about creating cutting-edge AI applications and thrive in a dynamic, fast-paced environment, we’d love to hear from you.
🟣 Your challenge at Quorvia 
• AI Product Development
- Build and deploy scalable AI products leveraging LLMs to support Quorvia’s payment orchestration platform.
- Develop and optimize prompts to ensure high-quality outputs from LLMs for specific use cases, such as customer service, fraud prevention, and payment assistance.
• Prompt Engineering
- Design, test, and iterate prompts to achieve optimal performance for AI models.
- Analyze and refine outputs based on feedback loops and user interaction data.
• Integration with Payment Systems
- Collaborate with cross-functional teams to integrate AI features into existing payment systems and workflows.
- Ensure seamless interaction between AI solutions and Quorvia’s core services.
• AI Research and Innovation
- Stay updated on advancements in LLMs, prompt engineering, and related AI fields.
- Experiment with emerging technologies to identify opportunities for Quorvia’s product innovation.
• Data Utilization
- Leverage payment and user interaction data to fine-tune AI models and improve product performance.
- Ensure adherence to data privacy regulations and best practices in AI ethics.
🟣 Skills you need
Minimum Qualifications
• Extensive Experience with LLMs: Proven track record of building and deploying products using models like GPT or similar.
• Extensive Experience with LLMs: Proven track record of building and deploying products using models like GPT or similar.
• Prompt Engineering Expertise: Ability to design, test, and optimize prompts for specific outcomes and use cases.
• Programming Proficiency: Strong experience with Python and frameworks like TensorFlow, PyTorch, or similar.
• API Integration: Expertise in integrating AI solutions with RESTful APIs and third-party platforms.
• Vector Database Knowledge: Hands-on experience with vector databases such as Pinecone, Weaviate, or FAISS for semantic search and embedding retrieval.
• Speech-to-Text and Text-to-Speech Technologies: Familiarity with tools like Whisper, AWS Polly, or Google Speech-to-Text for voice-based solutions.
• Scalability: Experience developing and deploying scalable AI systems in cloud environments (e.g., AWS, GCP, Azure).
• Problem-Solving Skills: Ability to conceptualize and implement AI-driven solutions for complex business challenges.
• Fluent English.
Preferred Qualifications
• Familiarity with NLP libraries like Hugging Face or OpenAI APIs.
• Strong analytical and data visualization skills.
🟣 What we offer at Quorvia
• Competitive Compensation
• Remote work - You can work from everywhere!
• Home Office Bonus - We offer a one time allowance to help you create your ideal home office.
• Work equipment
• Stock options
• Health Plan wherever you are
• Flexible Days off 
• Language, Professional and Personal growth courses
We may use artificial intelligence (AI) tools to support parts of the hiring process, such as reviewing applications, analyzing resumes, or assessing responses. These tools assist our recruitment team but do not replace human judgment. Final hiring decisions are ultimately made by humans. If you would like more information about how your data is processed or wish to exercise your data protection rights, please contact us at hiring@quorvia.com.
perfil:
Ingeniera de software con 6 años de experiencia en backend y datos.

- En Granix (agtech) construí pipelines de imágenes satelitales en Python y Airflow que procesaban 400 GB por semana.
- Migré a PostGIS el sistema de cálculo de superficies de lotes y bajé el tiempo de respuesta de 9 a 2 segundos.
- Diseñé un servicio de seguimiento en tiempo real en Go que recibe 50.000 eventos por minuto.
- Experiencia con AWS (S3, ECS, RDS), PostgreSQL y modelos de regresión para predicción de demanda.
